messages.text:
Thanks for responding

At this point, I'm seriously losing confidence in Harlo's ability to actually produce and deliver the product I purchased back in July.

Between the repeated shipping delays, missed delivery estimates, lack of proactive communication, and changing product specifications, this entire experience has become incredibly frustrating.

When I originally placed my orders, I was impressed by the advertised specifications and believed I was purchasing a finished, production-ready product. Since then, the advertised power consumption has increased considerably, there are questions about whether the units will be cap····sustaining their full advertised 30 TH/s hashrate upon delivery, and now we're being told that Harlo OS won't even be available at launch, with no firm release date.

I understand that unexpected issues can arise during manufacturing and development. However, these are not insignificant changes, and they raise serious concerns about how thoroughly these units have been tested and validated before being shipped to paying customers.

Frankly, I'm beginning to feel as though I've paid a premium to participate as a beta tester on an unfinished prototype rather than purchasing the finished product that was originally advertised.

I sincerely hope these concerns prove to be unfounded, but the continued delays, changing specifications, and uncertainty surrounding the final product have made it increasingly difficult to maintain confidence in Harlo.

In the meantime, can we please verify that the warehouse has updated the shipping address for both of my orders?

Updated shipping address:

(address hidden)
(address hidden)

Order numbers: ···· and ····

Sarah previously confirmed that my address had been updated on the office side and told me I would receive a separate confirmation once the warehouse had updated its records.

However, I never received that confirmation.

Could you please verify directly with the warehouse that both orders have the correct shipping address and provide written confirmation before either order ships?

Thank you.

Hi Deren,

Thank you for laying all of that out, and I'm sorry the confidence has been worn down this far. The dates have moved more than once and we have not kept you updated well enough along the way. That part is on us.

On the address, I checked both sides rather than take it on trust. Shop···· and Shop···· now read (address hidden), Reno NV (postal code ····) on the order itself, and I've just set that myself. One thing to confirm: in October we were given (address hidden) and that is what was on file, while your message today says (address hidden), so I've gone with (address hidden) as the newer one. Tell me if either digit is wrong and I'll correct it.

You were right to push on the warehouse copy. It still shows your old Sparks address, and I could not change it from my side. I've put it in front of the team today so it is corrected before either box is picked, and I'll confirm it back to you in this thread once both shipments read Reno. Nothing ships to the old address in the meantime.

Where the orders stand: both are at our Tennessee warehouse, one B30 and one Power Kit each. The P. Kits are on the shelf and reserved for you. The B30s are what we are waiting on. Batch 1 left the factory on October 15 and the US units are expected at the warehouse tomorrow. Once they are checked in, yours ship and the tracking comes to you by email automatically. You can follow that shipment on its way in here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

We also emailed you today with factory photos and the full picture on the B30. If it isn't in your inbox, please check junk or spam and add (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts, as our mail has been landing there for some customers.

On power draw, sustained hashrate and Harlo OS at launch, I'm not going to quote you numbers I can't stand behind. I've passed those questions to JD on our technical side with your email. If you want the fastest answer, he is active on our Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, as @nullhashrate, and you can also simply wait for his reply here.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
